steps.title: Start a draft
steps.body: Call it anything. Drafts are invisible to everyone outside the club until someone publishes them.

steps.title: Write a sentence
steps.body: It's saving as you type — there's no save button and you won't lose it.

steps.title: Use these styles, not hand formatting
steps.body: They're what the public site knows how to render. A heading you faked with bold text is a heading the site can't build a table of contents from.

steps.title: Two people, one document
steps.body: If someone else opens this post, their cursor appears here and you both just write. No merging, no "send me your version." On your own, this row is empty — that's expected.

steps.title: A second reader with opinions
steps.body: Some of them good. It doesn't know which details matter to us, so treat it as a reader, not an editor.

steps.title: Don't press it
steps.body: Read what it does instead: this puts the post on the public internet under the club's name, where it may be cached or indexed within minutes. Scheduling is behind the same control. Publishing is a decision, not a step in a sequence.

steps.title: Save it as a draft instead
steps.body: Drafts are free. Publish when a human has read it end to end.
